Role Purpose

The role will be a lead contributor to Banten & West Java Regional for B2B ICT & Telecommunication market. The primary focus of the Manager Banten & West Java Regional Segment is to collaborate with key internal and external partners to develop, produce and maintain high-impact, targeted project and opportunity. that support the B2B ICT & Telecommunication qualified leads within specific target revenue. The position is to identify study and understand Banten & West Java Regional segment and create opportunities and solutions to drive growth.

Deliverables is by acting as the technical-solution support between B2B Sales and customers need and request, by developing, designing, proposing solution, leading team on customer facing, doing consultative selling. Ingredient as an innovative and differentiated player in the market. Guide and execute an integrated go to market (GTM) across Banten & West Java Regional market.

The role holder has the responsibility to meet the overall Banten & West Java Regional segment revenue objective across IOH services by fully supporting the Sales team and Lead and manage acquisition drive across core and ICT propositions.

Area of Responsibilities

Area of Responsibilities:

1.Identifying and Understanding Customer Pain Points, Customer Business Value, & Solution Initiative Needed

• Proactively collaborate with the sales team to identify and understand customer pain points and needs, and align these insights with the IOH portfolio, whether the opportunities have already been identified or not.
• Maintain a deep understanding of industry trends and customer needs to inform solution development to capitalize on new business opportunities.
• Ensuring team capabilities in creating strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance business value based on segments.
• Develop strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance business value based on segments, collaborate with product team.
• Co-create customer proposals with team members.

2.Solution Proposal Validation and Escalation, Sharpening Solution Initiative to Become a Valid Project

• Oversee the solution proposals that been handle by the team, review and ensure the proposals meet the business requirements.
• Ensure solution initiatives are feasible, scalable, and aligned with IOH and users strategic objectives.
• Monitoring the result of the solution offered, ensure the proposals has been following the right IOH procedures, governance & policies and securing project contracts with team members.

3.Managing Clients and Stakeholders

• Leveraging and managing opportunity pipeline through stakeholders engagement.
• Assist VP in ensuring timely and effective collaborations with other functions, such as Product team, Procurement, partners, users, and client through the process and ensuring optimal results for all parties.

4.Talent Development and Management

• Evaluate team performance and dynamics in order to identify areas for improvement, enhance productivity, and foster a collaborative environment that supports the growth and development of individual team members. Implement regular feedbacks for team members.
• Provide coaching to team leaders to enhance their leadership skills.

5.Financial Strategy

• Ensuring healthy profit margin in every solution offered to ensure IOH business continuity.
• Monitor external factors (e.g., market trends, economic conditions) that could impact financial performance of solution offered.

6.Change Management

• Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise solution initiatives with sales.
• Monitor progress and make adjustments to ensure timely and effective change adoption.
• Monitor and analyze performance data to assess the impact of changes on business outcomes. Use insights from performance measurement to drive continuous improvement.

Requirements

Qualification:

• University graduate, in field of telecommunication or Information Engineering with min 3 year experience in Telco Operation/Planning/Project or Presales function.
• Preferably when Certified in ICT Solution (Security, IT Network, Data Center, etc)
• Able to work under limited direction and use initiative and judgment
• Flexible and adaptable in under pressure situations and meet short and long term deadlines
• Good in analytical and planning skill to translate customer requirement into matching product & solution

Skill & Competence

• Able to design and configure the Internet & Connectivity Service Network
• Able to design and integration ICT Solution
• Able to run and manage the project in term of enterprise service

Business Acumen

• Understand and know the Market Segment of Enterprise Service
• Understand the concept of basic business calculations
• Have a good initiative to create extra ordinary solutions that customers need

Communication Skill

• Has a good communication skill in Bahasa and English
• Has a good presentation skill
• Fluent in English, having sound verbal and written communication, strong negotiation presentation and report writing skills

wo-jpfa-JR45.d:
Job Summary:**

The Tallyman - RPU Megaluh at PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is responsible for accurately recording and verifying the quantities of incoming and outgoing goods, particularly livestock, within the RPU (Receiving and Processing Unit) Megaluh facility. This role ensures precise inventory management and adherence to operational procedures.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Accurately count and record the quantity of live animals received at the RPU Megaluh.
* Verify incoming livestock against delivery notes and purchase orders, identifying and reporting any discrepancies.
* Monitor and record the quantity of processed goods and by-products being dispatched from the facility.
* Prepare and maintain detailed tally sheets, daily reports, and other relevant documentation.
* Ensure all recording equipment and tools are in good working order.
* Communicate effectively with drivers, suppliers, and internal staff regarding cargo movements and counts.
* Adhere to all company policies, safety regulations, and hygiene standards.
* Assist in physical inventory counts as required.
* Report any damaged or substandard goods immediately to the supervisor.

Job Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Proven experience in a tallyman, inventory control, or similar role, preferably within a logistics, agricultural, or manufacturing environment.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in counting and record-keeping.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations quickly and accurately.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Physical stamina to stand for extended periods and work in varying environmental conditions typical of an RPU.
* Familiarity with basic inventory software or data entry is a plus.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends, if required.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Job Summary

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical PPIC (Production Planning and Inventory Control) Staff member to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, scheduling, and monitoring production processes, as well as managing inventory levels of raw materials and finished goods to ensure optimal efficiency, timely delivery, and minimal waste in alignment with our company’s high-quality standards.

Placement in Pemalang

Job Responsibilities:

* Develop and execute comprehensive production schedules based on sales forecasts, customer orders, and plant capacity.
* Monitor and manage inventory levels of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods to prevent stockouts or overstock situations.
* Coordinate closely with the Procurement, Production, Quality Control, and Logistics departments to ensure a smooth flow of materials and timely order fulfillment.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile discrepancies between physical inventory and system data.
* Analyze production efficiency, identify bottlenecks in the supply chain, and propose actionable solutions for continuous improvement.

Job Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in Production Planning and Inventory Control (PPIC), preferably in the manufacturing or feed/food processing industry.
* Strong proficiency in using ERP systems (such as SAP) and advanced MS Excel.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Great communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* High attention to detail and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
